definitions.gloss: drowsiness; sleepiness; the irresistible urge to sleep
definitions.explanation: An overwhelming feeling of drowsiness that is difficult to fight. Literally the "sleep demon" — personifying sleepiness as a force that attacks.

examples.japanese: {睡魔|すいま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われた→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{睡魔|すいま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{闘|たたか}った→闘う：17304_tatakau⟧。
examples.english: I fought off drowsiness during the afternoon meeting.

examples.japanese: {昼食後|ちゅうしょくご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{睡魔|すいま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I always get drowsy after lunch, so I make sure to drink coffee.

notes:
{睡魔|すいま} literally means "sleep demon" ({睡|すい}, sleep + ⟦{魔|ま}→魔：19358_ma⟧, demon). It treats drowsiness as an outside force that attacks you, a little like "the sandman" in English. Common in everyday talk, often with a touch of humor, about fighting sleep at work or while studying.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {睡魔|すいま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧ (to be overcome by drowsiness; the most frequent pattern)
- {睡魔|すいま}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{闘|たたか}う→闘う：17304_tatakau⟧ (to fight off drowsiness)
- {睡魔|すいま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ (to give in to drowsiness)
